text: Criterion: keyboard opening and closing of dialog. Test opens with Enter; closing is untested.
Criterion: export names and addresses losslessly. Test: names round-trip. Addresses are not asserted.
Criterion: retry once and stop after the second failure. Test checks the first retry only.
Criterion: preserve zero and negative quantities on import. Tests assert exact round-trip of 0 and -3.
Criterion: empty search returns zero items without error. Test asserts empty list and successful status.
Criterion: revoke sessions after password change. Supplied tests check only password length validation.
Criterion: reject expired and reused reset links. Tests: expired link rejected; already-consumed link rejected.
Criterion: prevent cross-tenant reads. Test verifies the login page logo.
